offering_description.value: Designs, makes and markets aluminum foil, plastic wrap, parchment paper, trash bags, food storage bags and disposable tableware under its own brands. Sells mainly through grocery, mass and club retailers to household consumers.

primary_products.value: aluminum foil; plastic wrap; parchment paper; trash bags; food storage bags; disposable tableware

customer_segment.value: B2C: household consumers buying kitchen and cleaning products

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded household products sold to retailers and consumers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets its brands, sold to grocery and mass retailers; OEM / manufacturer: makes foil, wrap, bags and tableware from purchased resin and aluminum, sold to retailers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: foil, wraps, parchment, bags and tableware sharing retail customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: grocery, mass merchant and club stores; online: retailer websites and online grocery platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food-contact material and labeling rules from FDA and FTC
